System OFF Power Measurements — nRF54L15 DK / nRF54LM20 DK / nRF54LS05 DK

中文

Updated: 2026-10-30

1. Test conditions

ItemDetails
BoardsnRF54L15 DK v1.0.0 (PCA10156), SoC nRF54L15 Rev 2, target nrf54l15dk/nrf54l15/cpuapp; nRF54LM20 DK v0.7.0 (PCA10184), SoC nRF54LM20B Engineering B (ENGB), target nrf54lm20dk/nrf54lm20b/cpuapp; nRF54LS05 DK v0.3.1 (PCA10214), SoC nRF54LS05B Rev 1, target nrf54ls05dk/nrf54ls05b/cpuapp
SDKNCS v3.4.1 (sysbuild)
FirmwareThis sample (system_off), which enters System OFF on every boot; CONFIG_PM_DEVICE and PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME on; DC/DC on; low-frequency clock is the LFXO
Modespin: sw0 wake-up, GRTC and the low-frequency clock are stopped before System OFF, no RAM retained. grtc: GRTC wake-up after 10 s, no RAM retained. ret: sw0 wake-up, 4 KB retained_mem retained (-S pinwake -S retram)
SupplyPPK2 in source meter mode, 3.0 V, 100,000 samples per second
InstrumentNordic Power Profiler app (PPK2); the window of each plot is listed in section 3
Not recordedThe screenshots do not record whether the log and SWD were on or off; the ambient temperature was not recorded

2. Datasheet values

Conditions: VDD = 3 V, 25 °C, DC/DC, reference circuit. "RAM" in System OFF means the amount of retained RAM.

DeviceSymbolConditionTypical
nRF54L15 / L10 / L05IOFF0System OFF, wake on pin, 0 KB RAM retained0.7 µA
nRF54L15 / L10 / L05IOFF1System OFF, wake on pin + GRTC (LFXO), 0 KB RAM retained0.9 µA
nRF54LM20A / BIOFF0System OFF, wake on pin, 0 KB RAM retained0.7 µA
nRF54LM20A / BIOFF1System OFF, wake on pin + GRTC (LFXO), 0 KB RAM retained1.0 µA
nRF54LS05A / BIOFF0System OFF, wake on pin, 0 KB RAM retained0.6 µA (marked as estimated in the datasheet)
nRF54LS05A / BIOFF1System OFF, wake on pin + GRTC (LFXO), 0 KB RAM retained0.7 µA (marked as estimated in the datasheet)

- The datasheet gives System OFF for these two conditions only. There is no entry with retained RAM, and no values by temperature or voltage. - In this sample pin corresponds to IOFF0 and grtc (LFXO) to IOFF1; ret (4 KB retained) has no datasheet entry. - Erratum 37 (L15 Engineering B, Revision 1, Revision 2): entering System OFF too soon after a pin reset or power-up gives a higher current. SystemInit() in NCS v3.4.1 already contains the workaround, so a build with NCS needs nothing extra.

5. The third RAM section of nRF54LS05B

The LS05B has 96 KB (3 sections of 32 KB), but the nrfx RAM table lists only 2 sections for nRF54LS05, so sys_poweroff() clears only bits 0 and 1 of POWER[0].RET. The retention of the third section (0x20010000–0x20017FFF) stays on. extra_ram_off() in main.c also clears bit 2 when APP_USE_RETAINED_MEM is off.

6. Reproduce

west build -b <board> --sysbuild -S pinwake            -- -DSNIPPET_ROOT=<sample dir>   # pin
west build -b <board> --sysbuild -S grtcwake           -- -DSNIPPET_ROOT=<sample dir>   # grtc
west build -b <board> --sysbuild -S pinwake -S retram  -- -DSNIPPET_ROOT=<sample dir>   # ret

Build each configuration once with -p (pristine) so that an old CMake cache does not carry in an old configuration.
